description: Four original generated Hindi host performances. Same-frame tracked foreground keeps the walking host and physical hand in front of the server-controlled SVG wheel. This is animated presentation, not a live camera feed.

welcome.prompt: A single continuous locked-off 16:9 tripod broadcast shot, matching the input image's studio and composition exactly. Same adult Indian female presenter in the blue dress, same face, hair, microphone, shoes and lighting. Wheel, pointer, sign, pedestal, floor and camera stay fixed. Wheel remains perfectly stationary. Keep her whole body and feet in view, entirely in the open stage space to the RIGHT of the wheel, never crossing or hiding the wheel face. Natural human skin, grounded feet, heel-to-toe footsteps, weight transfer, dress and hair motion, no sliding or teleporting. No camera zoom, cuts, subtitles, graphics, music or crowd. Her microphone carries clear warm confident Indian female Hindi speech with precise visible lip synchronization, like a professional live game-show anchor. ACTION: She actively hosts while walking. During seconds 0-4 she takes THREE clearly visible natural steps diagonally toward the front-right of the stage, about one metre from her starting mark. She faces camera while speaking and makes a welcoming open-palm gesture. During seconds 4-8 she turns slightly and takes THREE visible natural steps back to her original mark beside the wheel, still speaking and making eye contact with the camera. During seconds 8-10 she settles naturally into the exact original pose. Her horizontal position must visibly travel, not just sway in place. Never go farther right than 86 percent of the frame. DIALOGUE, spoken naturally across seconds 0.3-8.5 with bright anchoring energy: 'Namaskar! Wheel two point zero mein aapka swagat hai. Main hoon aapki host. Apna number chuniye, naya round shuru ho raha hai!' Sound: her clear close-microphone Hindi voice and subtle genuine footsteps. This is a talking and walking presenter performance, not a silent idle loop.

spin.prompt: Photoreal single continuous locked tripod broadcast wide shot. EXACT input composition, same adult woman in blue dress holding microphone, fixed wheel centre/size, same lighting and set. No cuts, zoom, captions, music or crowd. She is a professional Hindi game-show anchor with a warm confident Indian female voice and accurate visible lip sync. Seconds 0-2: she faces camera and announces clearly: 'Bets band! Chaliye, wheel ghumate hain!' Seconds 2-3: she takes ONE natural step towards the wheel and visibly grasps its outer RIGHT rim at two o'clock with her free hand. Seconds 3-4: she firmly pulls the rim DOWN clockwise toward four o'clock, bending naturally with visible effort and real hand contact; she then releases. The disk moves ONLY when she pulls. Keep her fingers on the outer rim, never across the inner wheel face. Seconds 4-8: she steps back to her original standing mark, watches the spinning wheel and continues speaking excitedly into the microphone: 'Wheel ghoom raha hai! Nazar rakhiye, dekhte hain kaunsa number aata hai!' During seconds 8-10 she smiles and looks from wheel to camera, returning to the exact starting pose. Mechanical ticking slows as the wheel coasts. Real heel-to-toe foot contact, body weight, fingers, breathing, cloth motion. Human performance, not a mannequin. Only the disk rotates, structure and pointer stay absolutely fixed. Clear Hindi commentary is prominent, no music.
